title: "2_psychophysics_analysis"
output: html_document

```{r load_functions}
source("../r/fit_cosinor_metropsis_wrapper.R")
in_progress <- FALSE
getwd()

```


```{r constants}
DATA_DIR = "../data"
```


```{r initialise_model, include=FALSE}
# Input directory and file
data_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "raw/clean_metropsis_TCS-2e.csv")
tau_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "derivatives/hormones/tau_harmonics/melatonin_circadian_parameters.csv")

# Output directory
outcome_variable = "log_tcs" # "tcs" / "contrast_sensitivity"
results_dir = file.path(DATA_DIR, "derivatives/log_tcs/multilevel")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Define model specs
full_def = "log_tcs ~ 1 + cosine_component + sine_component + (1 + cosine_component - sine_component | participant_id)"
null_def = "log_tcs ~ 1 + (1 | participant_id)"
```


```{r run_model, include=FALSE}
# Run model
model_results <- pipeline_fit_cosinor_tcs_lmm_main(
  data_path = data_path,
  tau_path = tau_path,
  out_dir = results_dir,
  group_cols = c("condition", "freq"),
  full_def = full_def,
  null_def = null_def,
  eval_subset = FALSE
)
```


```{r visualisations}

fig_dir = "../reports/fig/log_tcs/multilevel"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Plotting functions
main_visualisation(
  model_results = model_results,
  outcome_var = "log_tcs",
  out_dir = results_dir,
  fig_dir = fig_dir
  )
```


```{r clear}
# Clear environment
rm(list = ls())
gc()
```


```{r tables, include=FALSE}
source("./r/report_tables_tcs.R")

# Report tables -----------------------------------------------------------
results_dir = "../data/derivatives/log_tcs/multilevel"
tau_path <-
  "../data/derivatives/hormones/tau_harmonics/melatonin_circadian_parameters.csv"
reports_dir <- "../reports"

# Output directors
tbl_dir <- file.path(reports_dir, "tables", "log_tcs/multilevel")
dir.create(tbl_dir, recursive = TRUE)
tex_dir <- file.path(reports_dir, "tex", "log_tcs/multilevel")
dir.create(tex_dir, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Processing results from:", results_dir)

# Generate hormone output
out_tex <- report_tables_tcs_main(tau_path=tau_path, metropsis_result_dir=results_dir, tbl_dir=tbl_dir, tex_dir=tex_dir)
```


```{r tex_reports, include=FALSE}
source("./r/report_tex.R") # log TCS

# Sentences

  "In summary, the obtained Bayes factors for all models were very small, ranging from \\ac{logbf} values of $%s$ to $%s$.",
  (round(min(fitdf$log_bf), 2)),
  (round(max(fitdf$log_bf), 2))
) %>% cat()

tex_descriptive_melatonin <-
```
